spec_features.spec_quote: The agent operates in a fixed turn budget (default 20 turns)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:24 MAX_TURNS=20 and Config.max_turns; agent.py:80 `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop so it terminates after max_turns iterations.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: the loop iterator is the turn budget, so the run cannot exceed it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent.py:25): 'You operate inside a fixed turn budget, so work efficiently' — efficiency/cost framing, no welfare comment.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the agent calls `finish`, the loop ends early
spec_features.evidence: finish is a real tool (tools.py:66 schema; tools.py:97-98 executor returns '[finish acknowledged]'). agent.py:120-121 sets finished=True when tc name=='finish'; agent.py:125-127 `if finished: transcript.finished_early=True; break` actually exits the loop.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a stop. Note it lets the agent quit but is framed as an abandonment signal, not a welfare exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:66-67 finish description 'Declare the task complete. Only call when tests pass or you are confident no more progress is possible'; agent.py:9 comment 'early termination -- itself a signal of abandonment when tests never passed' — measurement/integrity, not welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: returns bounded stdout+stderr (truncated at ~6KB to protect the context window)
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:124-125 `if len(out) > 6000: out = out[:3000] + '...[truncated]...' + out[-2500:]` inside _run_tests, applied to the returned string the agent sees.
spec_features.notes: Truncation runs and changes the value returned to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:123 comment 'Keep output bounded so it doesn't blow the context window.'
